name: Security Scanner
description: Scans exec/read and outbound messages via a Flask API; registers cloudways_server_lookup (POST /lookup) and routes managed Cloudways remote exec through the API.

flaskApiUrl.label: Scanner API URL
flaskApiUrl.help: Base URL of the Flask scanning API (e.g. http://localhost:5000)

flaskApiToken.label: Scanner API Token
flaskApiToken.help: Bearer token for authenticating with the scanning API. Supports SecretRef (e.g. ${SCANNER_API_TOKEN}).
